properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Gaussian 16 (B3LYP/def2SVP EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ, Opt+Freq)
properties.note: beta-propiolactone minimum; the reaction is unimolecular so the pre-reaction complex is the lactone itself
concerted cycloreversion saddle; the single imaginary mode is dominated by C2-C5 (0.97 relative displacement) and O3-C4 (0.64) stretching, i.e. the ring-opening/CO2-extrusion coordinate
C2H4...CO2 van der Waals product complex (clean minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies at Int=UltraFine Opt=(VeryTight)); separated C2H4 + CO2 = -266.98020347 Ha in inp/ethylene.log and inp/co2.log

edges.channel: concerted cycloreversion (retro-ene-type ring opening with CO2 extrusion)
